computers.q: I'm not great with computers. Can I use this?
computers.a: Yes. It was designed for busy agents: big text, clear buttons and one step at a time. If you can fill in a form, you can use RealtyBoost.

accuracy.q: Will the AI make things up about the house?
accuracy.a: It writes only from the facts you enter, and we tell it never to invent features. You should still read everything before you use it — you're the expert.

posting.q: Does it post to my social media for me?
posting.a: Not yet. You copy and paste with one click, so you stay in control of what goes out.

privacy.q: Who can see my clients and listings?
privacy.a: Only you (and teammates on a Team plan). Your data is kept separate from every other account.

cancel.a: Yes. There are no contracts. Cancel from your billing page in two clicks.

languages.q: Can it write the same listing in two languages?
languages.a: Yes. Tick more than one language and you'll get each version side by side.

listing.title: Add a listing
listing.body: Go to My listings and press "Add a listing". Fill in what you know — the address is the only must.

create.title: Pick what to create
create.body: On the listing's page, click a box: MLS description, social posts, video plan, email or photo guide.

copy.title: Copy and use it
copy.body: Press the big Copy button and paste it into your MLS, Facebook or email. Read it first — you're the expert.

page.title: Publish a listing page
page.body: On the listing's page, press "Create the page". Share the link in your posts. (Pro plan)

leads.title: Follow up with leads
leads.body: New leads appear in Contacts with reminders. Press "What do I say?" for a call script, a text and an email.

photos.q: How does the photo guide know what to do?
photos.a:
It uses your phone model, the rooms and features you entered, and which way the house faces. It tells you the best time of day, the settings for your phone, what to shoot in each room, and how to edit for free.

Tip: fill in "Which way does the front of the house face?" on the listing for the best lighting advice.

languages.q: How do I write in Spanish (or another language)?
languages.a: Go to Settings → Languages and pick your languages. Then, when you create something, tick every language you want. You'll get each version side by side.

fairHousing.q: What is the Fair Housing check?
fairHousing.a: Fair Housing law says ads must describe the property, not the people who should live there. Every piece of writing is checked automatically. If we changed or removed anything, we tell you exactly what and why. It's a safety net, not legal advice — ask your broker when unsure.

coach.a: When a lead reaches out, the Coach writes what to say on the phone, answers to common questions, a text, an email and a 2-week follow-up plan. It's great for new agents and for busy days. You send messages yourself from your own phone or email.

pipeline.q: How do I move a deal to the next stage?
pipeline.a: On the Pipeline page, drag the card to the next column. If dragging is awkward, use the "Move to" menu at the bottom of each card.

cma.q: Is the price analysis an appraisal?
cma.a: No. You choose the comparable homes and the adjustment values. We do the math and draft a clear explanation for your client. The price recommendation is yours.

install.q: Can I put RealtyBoost on my phone's home screen?
install.a:
Yes.
iPhone or iPad: open RealtyBoost in Safari, tap the Share button, then "Add to Home Screen".
Android: open it in Chrome, tap the ⋮ menu, then "Install app" or "Add to Home screen".
Computer: in Chrome or Edge, click the install icon at the right end of the address bar.

privacy.q: Who can see my contacts and listings?
privacy.a: Only you — and your teammates if you're on a Team plan. Every account's data is kept separate in our database. The only public pages are the listing pages you choose to publish.

billing.q: How do I change or cancel my plan?
billing.a: Go to Settings → Plan and billing. You can switch plans or cancel there. There are no contracts.

help.contactBody: Email us any question. We usually reply within one business day.
